scope: Explicit reconstruction of the pure-state Pauli moment and same-input rank-12 threshold in 121. No new class or independent review.
pure_sector_identities: Define A_k as the sum of squared expectations of all weight-k Hermitian four-qubit Pauli strings, A_0=1, A_1=S, and C=Tr(rho tilde(rho)). For each subset T, 2^|T| Tr(rho_T^2)=sum_{support(w) subset T} <sigma_w>^2. Summing over all triples gives 8 sum_i Tr(rho_bar_i^2)=4+3A1+2A2+A3. By pure complementary Schmidt spectra this left side is 8 sum_i Tr(rho_i^2)=16+4S. Therefore A3=12+S-2A2. Global purity gives 1+S+A2+A3+A4=16, hence A4=3-2S+A2. Full spin flip has sign (-1)^k on weight-k Pauli strings, so 16C=1-S+A2-A3+A4 and A2=2+S+4C.
actual_gram_conjugations: Let V be the 16x12 matrix of actual columns sigma_i^a psi. Its row Gram is F=VV^dagger and its column Gram G=V^dagger V is Hermitian PSD; Tr F^2=Tr G^2. On the four diagonal 3x3 site blocks, diagonal entries are 1 and the six ordered off-diagonal entries have squared total 2|r_i|^2, giving 12+2S. Across distinct sites, each weight-two Pauli expectation appears once per ordered pair, giving 2A2. Thus Tr F^2=12+2S+2A2=16+4S+8C; imaginary Pauli commutator entries are retained, not discarded or realified.
rank12_kyfan: F is a sum of the twelve rank-one PSD outer products above, hence rank(F)<=12 and Tr F=12. If x=K3(F), Cauchy on the top three and the at most nine remaining nonzero eigenvalues gives Tr F^2>=x^2/3+(12-x)^2/9. The right side is strictly increasing for x>=8, where its value is 208/9, so 4S+8C<=64/9 implies x<=8, including equality or rank below 12. Equality at both threshold and x=8 requires top eigenvalues 8/3 three times and remaining nonzero eigenvalues 4/9 nine times, as previously recorded conditionally in 129.
actual_input_and_boundary: This uses one actual pure psi and does not assert any unrelated covariance or frame-compression rank. Mixed states are handled only by fixing one actual Q while averaging pure-input channel traces, not by substituting a mixed-state C or averaging the nonlinear criterion. The false projected-frame rank<=8 body 148 remains withdrawn under 149 and is not used.
